Section 7.7 – Pesticides and Pharmaceuticals Recognize and describe the shapes and functional groups for molecules used as pesticides and pharmaceuticals (Problems 31–36). • Pesticides and pharmaceuticals are molecules that include functional groups such as phenyl groups, alcohols, ethers, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids, amines, and amides. Many of these structures have more than one ring, which gives them characteristic three-dimensional shapes that are important for their biological functions.
